steps.title: Get Poki Setup
steps.does: Downloads the Poki Setup DMG from the channel's release, checks it against SHA256SUMS-desktop.txt, checks its Developer ID signature and notarization, and copies the app to ~/Applications.

steps.title: Start Poki Setup without a window
steps.does: Starts the app's poki-setup-bridge helper over a pipe and reads its version.

steps.title: Choose the release channel
steps.does: Sets the channel (alpha by default) for the install and for later renewals.

steps.title: Sign in with the Apple Account
steps.does: Reuses Poki Setup's own sign-in, or a password from the environment or the login keychain; otherwise asks in Poki Setup windows for the email, the password and then the two-factor code.

steps.title: Find the iPhone
steps.does: Waits until one iPhone is plugged in by USB.

steps.title: Pair, turn on Developer Mode, sign and install Poki
steps.does: Runs Poki Setup's install: Trust This Computer, Developer Mode, team, release, signing, install, pairing file and developer disk image.

steps.title: Trust the developer and open Poki
steps.does: Asks the person to trust the Apple Account in VPN & Device Management and open Poki once. When Poki first opens it asks for Automation Mode: the person taps Continue and enters the iPhone passcode on iOS's screen. If they cancel, Poki asks again only after it is turned on again. Poki says it is open by writing Documents/PokiSetup/poki-hello.json, which the installer reads through Poki Setup or Xcode's devicectl; with neither, the agent confirms with done open_poki.

steps.title: Give Poki the model key (only when asked)
steps.does: With --model-key <provider>, reads the key from the Mac's login keychain (item <provider>-api-key, or --model-key-item) into memory, seals it to the key Poki made on the phone, writes only the sealed file into Poki, and waits until Poki says it took it. Skipped without --model-key.

steps.title: Connect Poki to this iPhone
steps.does: Reads from Poki whether its local connection (10.7.0.1) answers. When it does not, says the one sentence Poki gives for the VPN app on the phone, and waits until Poki says it answers.

steps.title: Deploy the relay (optional)
steps.does: Deploys the relay Worker with a Cloudflare token from CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or the token Poki Setup already keeps. Skipped without one.

steps.title: Self-check
steps.does: Reads the install record, the phone's Developer Mode and pairing state, mounts the developer disk image and checks the relay.

apple_dialog.say: A Poki Setup window opens on this Mac. Type your Apple Account email, click Continue, then type its password in the next window. Poki Setup keeps the password in this Mac's keychain; do not type it here in the chat. I continue by myself once you click Continue.

apple_code_dialog.say: Apple sent a 6-digit code to {via}. Type it in the Poki Setup window on this Mac and click Continue. Do not type the code here in the chat.

apple_password.say: Store your Apple Account password in this Mac's keychain. In Terminal, run: security add-generic-password -U -s poki-setup-install -a YOUR_APPLE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL -w (it asks for the password and does not show it). I continue by myself once it is there.

apple_code.say: Apple sent a 6-digit code to {via}. In your own Terminal, run: {codeCommand} (it asks for the code and does not show it). Do not type the code here in the chat. I continue by myself once it is handed over.

phone_plug.say: Plug the iPhone into this Mac with a USB data cable and unlock it.

pair.say: On the iPhone, tap Trust and enter the passcode.

devmode.say: On the iPhone, open Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode, turn it on and tap Restart. After the restart, tap Turn On and enter the passcode.

pairing_file.say: Open Poki on the iPhone and scan the code Poki Setup shows to give it the pairing file.

open_poki.say: On the iPhone, open Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, tap your Apple Account under Developer App, tap Trust, then open Poki from the Home Screen and keep it open for a moment. I see by myself when Poki is open.

open_poki_tell.say: On the iPhone, open Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, tap your Apple Account under Developer App, tap Trust, then open Poki from the Home Screen. Tell me when Poki is open.

loopback.say: Poki needs a VPN app on the iPhone that lets it reach 10.7.0.1. In Poki, open Setup > Connect to this iPhone and follow the one line for your VPN app. I see by myself when it works.

setup_download_failed.reason: A release asset or its metadata could not be downloaded from GitHub.
setup_download_failed.agent_fix: Requests make at most 3 attempts; assets switch to the release asset API after a 5xx or connection failure. If both routes fail, report the URL/status and rerun later.

setup_checksum_mismatch.reason: The downloaded DMG does not match SHA256SUMS-desktop.txt.
setup_checksum_mismatch.agent_fix: The download is deleted and fetched again once. If it still does not match, stop and report it; never run the file.

setup_signature_invalid.reason: Poki Setup is not signed with Poki's Developer ID (team Q64ZL36CJN) or is not notarized.
setup_signature_invalid.agent_fix: Stop. Do not run the app. Report it with the diagnostics bundle.

setup_app_missing.reason: No Poki Setup.app where the installer looks (the run's folder, ~/Applications, /Applications).
setup_app_missing.agent_fix: Run node bin/install-iphone.mjs run, which downloads and checks Poki Setup, or pass --app-dir or --bridge to say where it is.

bridge_start_failed.reason: The poki-setup-bridge helper did not start or did not say ready.
bridge_start_failed.agent_fix: Delete ~/Applications/Poki Setup.app if this installer put it there and run again; it downloads a fresh copy.

usbmuxd_unreachable.reason: macOS's usbmuxd service did not answer, or answers with no devices (see issue #6).
usbmuxd_unreachable.agent_fix: Ask the person to unplug and plug the iPhone in again with a data cable, unlocked. Then run diagnose: it compares what usbmuxd, USB and devicectl see.
usbmuxd_unreachable.person: Plug the iPhone in again with a data cable and unlock it.

several_phones.reason: More than one iPhone is plugged in.
several_phones.agent_fix: Run again with --udid set to the iPhone the person wants (list them with node bin/install-iphone.mjs phones).

phone_locked.reason: The iPhone is locked, and iOS refuses the request.
phone_locked.agent_fix: Ask the person to unlock the iPhone; the step runs again by itself.
phone_locked.person: Unlock the iPhone and keep it on the Home Screen.

trust_not_answered.reason: Nobody tapped Trust on the iPhone in time, or someone tapped Don't Trust.
trust_not_answered.agent_fix: Ask the person to tap Trust and enter the passcode; the install step runs again by itself.
trust_not_answered.person: Tap Trust on the iPhone and enter the passcode. If you tapped Don't Trust, unplug the cable and plug it in again.

developer_mode_off.reason: Developer Mode is still off. iOS turns it on only after the person confirms on the phone.
developer_mode_off.agent_fix: Ask the person to turn on Developer Mode; the install step runs again by itself.
developer_mode_off.person: Open Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode, turn it on, tap Restart, then tap Turn On after the restart.

apple_credentials_missing.reason: No Apple Account password: none in Poki Setup, POKI_SETUP_PASSWORD or the keychain item poki-setup-install, and the person closed the Poki Setup window.
apple_credentials_missing.agent_fix: Ask the person whether to sign in now; run the command again and the Poki Setup window opens again. Never ask for the password in chat.

apple_sign_in_rejected.reason: Apple refused the Apple Account email or password.
apple_sign_in_rejected.agent_fix: The keychain item poki-setup-install is deleted so the person can store the right password; the step waits for it.
apple_sign_in_rejected.person: Store the correct password with the same keychain command.

apple_code_wrong.reason: Apple refused the two-factor code (wrong or expired).
apple_code_wrong.agent_fix: Ask the person to paste the same command from the apple_code prompt (the full path, with --state when it shows one) in their own Terminal again with the newest code; the step waits for it. Never take the code in chat.

apple_server_busy.reason: Apple or the anisette server answered with an error (HTTP 5xx or -80045/-80046).
apple_server_busy.agent_fix: Switch to the next anisette server and retry.

apple_account_limit.reason: The Apple Account reached a free-account limit: the 10 App IDs a week, the 3 apps at a time, or one development certificate that another sideloading tool (AltStore, SideStore, Xcode) already holds.
apple_account_limit.agent_fix: Stop and tell the person which limit Apple named. Revoking another tool's certificate or waiting a week is their decision.

network.agent_fix: Retry with a short backoff; if it keeps failing, report it.

sign_failed.reason: Signing the IPA for the team failed.
sign_failed.agent_fix: Stop and run diagnose; attach the bundle to an issue draft.

ddi_refused.reason: Apple refused to sign the developer disk image.
ddi_refused.agent_fix: Update Xcode to support this iOS version (iOS 27 requires Xcode 27). Open Xcode once and let its components finish installing, then rerun the same command. Poki does not need to be reinstalled.

install_failed.agent_fix: Retry once with the phone unlocked; then stop and run diagnose.

relay_failed.reason: Deploying or checking the relay failed. Poki works on the phone without a relay.
relay_failed.agent_fix: Report it, finish the install, and point the person to Poki Setup's Relay page.

check_failed.reason: Poki is installed but the self-check found something not ready.
check_failed.agent_fix: Read the check fields in the result, fix what the matching code says, and run again.

model_key_missing.reason: --model-key was given, but the Mac's login keychain has no item with that name, or it is empty.
model_key_missing.agent_fix: Tell the person which keychain item was looked for. They can add it in their own Terminal with security add-generic-password -U -s <item> -a "$USER" -w, or type the key in Poki (Agents > Accounts and Models). Never ask for the key in chat.

model_key_not_taken.reason: The sealed key is in Poki, but Poki did not say it took it in time (it reads the file while it is in front).
model_key_not_taken.agent_fix: Ask the person to bring Poki to the front, then run the command again; the key is sealed again for the phone's new key.
model_key_not_taken.person: Open Poki and keep it in front for a moment.

node_too_old.reason: The installer runs on Node.js 24 or later.
node_too_old.agent_fix: Install Node.js 24 or later, or use Poki Setup's own command line tool (poki-setup next --json).

unknown.reason: An error the installer does not recognise.
unknown.agent_fix: Run diagnose and issue, show the draft to the person, and submit it only after they agree.
